steps.title: Charge
steps.imageAlt: G Pen Connect Micro USB charging

bullets.text: Plug a **Micro USB cable** into the port on the side of the battery housing.
LED blinks **8 times** when the battery is low.

steps.title: Set Up
steps.imageAlt: Assembling the G Pen Connect on a water piece

bullets.text: Twist the **tank** onto the top of the adapter.
Twist the **male glass adapter** onto the bottom of the adapter.
Insert the adapter into the **14mm female joint** of your water piece.

note.text: **14mm male adapter** fits standard water pieces. Other adapter sizes available separately.

steps.title: Load
steps.imageAlt: Loading concentrate into the G Pen Connect tank

bullets.text: Remove the **tank cover** and load concentrate onto the **ceramic plate** inside.
Attach the **battery** to the tank to complete the connection.

steps.title: Heat & Draw
steps.imageAlt: Heating and drawing through the G Pen Connect

bullets.text: **Click 5 times** to power on. LED lights up in your current voltage color.
Draw through your water piece while heating.

press.sub: 5 clicks to power on or off
5s heat-up flash, then 10s max solid heat
Hold the side button during a session

note.text: **After consecutive max-heat sessions:** Wait at least 2 minutes before touching the tank cover.

faq.question: Device won't turn on
faq.answer: Click the button 5 times quickly. Make sure the battery is attached to the tank. The connection must be complete for power to work. If nothing happens, charge the device first.

faq.question: LED blinks 3 times on startup
faq.answer: Three blinks usually means a short circuit or the tank isn't properly connected. Remove the battery, check the tank connection, reattach firmly, and try again.

faq.question: Vapor is thin or has poor flavor
faq.answer: Try a higher voltage setting (3× to cycle). Make sure the concentrate is on the ceramic plate, not the walls of the chamber. Clean the tank regularly. Residue buildup is the most common cause of reduced performance.

faq.question: Tank cover is too hot to handle
faq.answer: This is normal after consecutive max-heat sessions. Wait at least 2 minutes before touching the tank cover. The tank surface is designed to get hot. That's how it vaporizes concentrate efficiently.
